description: This Java class `ClientRequestFactory` provides factory methods for creating default client request objects for testing purposes within the Fineract project. It utilizes utility methods for generating random names and IDs and is annotated as a Spring component for dependency injection.

classes.name: ClientRequestFactory
classes.description: A Spring component class that constructs default client creation requests for testing.

methods.name: defaultClientCreationRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a pre-filled `PostClientsRequest` object with default test data, including random client names and IDs.

methods.name: randomClientId
methods.description: Generates a random client ID string with a specified prefix and suffix length.
